heightmap.description: Project-relative grayscale PNG or unsigned little-endian r16 path. Rows run along +Z, columns along +X.

resolution.description: Sample counts [width, height], including the last row/column.

material.description: Project-relative material JSON; empty uses a green material. Terrain texture maps repeat.

details.description: Decorative GPU-instanced scatter rules. At most 250000 candidate placements per terrain; rejected height/slope candidates are omitted. No collision or navigation obstacles are generated.

model.description: Required for kind=model; empty for built-in kinds. Project-relative static model with a ground-level pivot.

material.description: Optional material JSON applied to all meshes; empty uses white, with built-in vertex colors.

slope.description: Inclusive min/max terrain-local slope in degrees.

draw_distance.description: World-space camera distance; defaults to 60 for grass, 250 otherwise. Grass shrinks over the last 20%.

align_to_normal.description: Tilt to the terrain surface; defaults true for rocks and false otherwise.

shadows.description: Cast shadows; defaults false for grass and true otherwise.

layers.description: Up to eight material layers. Use instead of an enabled legacy blend object. Weights are normalized; an empty weight sum selects layer 0.

material.description: Project-relative material JSON or color image.

tile_size.description: Terrain-local units per texture repeat in X/Z.

height.description: Increasing fade-in start/end and fade-out start/end heights. Equal endpoints give a hard edge.

slope.description: Increasing fade-in start/end and fade-out start/end slope angles in degrees.

control_maps.description: Optional RGBA weight maps: channels of map 0 select layers 0-3, map 1 selects 4-7. Supply one map per four layers. Replaces height/slope rules; layer weight still multiplies its mask.

blend.description: Optional automatic grass/dirt/rock material blending. Supply all three image or material JSON paths to enable. Heights and slopes are terrain-local; thresholds must be increasing. An empty object disables blending.

grass.description: Project-relative grass image or material JSON (including procedural materials).

dirt.description: Project-relative low-ground image or material JSON.

rock.description: Project-relative steep-slope image or material JSON.

dirt_height.description: Full dirt below the first local height, fading to grass at the second.

rock_slope.description: Rock starts at the first slope angle and covers the surface at the second, in degrees.

noise_scale.description: Transition noise frequency per local terrain unit.

noise_strength.description: Transition variation as a fraction of each blend range; zero gives smooth height/slope bands.
